key.name: speech-language
key.summary: Dictation language (ISO-639-1 code or 'auto')

key.name: speech-recent-languages
key.summary: Languages shown first in the dictation language menu

key.name: speech-engine
key.summary: Dictation engine: auto (GroqType when installed with an API key, else local whisper.cpp), whisper or groqtype

key.name: speech-model
key.summary: whisper.cpp model name (tiny, base, small, medium, large-v3-turbo, …)

key.name: speech-threads
key.summary: Transcription threads (0 = automatic)

key.name: speech-max-seconds
key.summary: Maximum dictation length in seconds

key.name: speech-silence-stop
key.summary: Stop dictation automatically after a pause

key.name: active-language
key.summary: Dictionary used for suggestions

key.name: suggestions-enabled
key.summary: Show word completion suggestions above the keys

key.name: auto-space
key.summary: Insert a space after picking a suggestion

key.name: autocorrect
key.summary: Fix clear typos when a word is finished with a space or punctuation
key.description: Backspace right after a correction puts back what you typed, and that word is not corrected again.

key.name: text-shortcuts
key.summary: Text shortcuts: typing the shortcut and a space types the phrase

key.name: emoji-suggestions
key.summary: Offer an emoji for the word just typed in the suggestion bar

key.name: double-space-period
key.summary: Double-tap the space bar to type a period and a space

key.name: learn-words
key.summary: Learn words you type (stored locally only)

key.name: hold-for-numbers
key.summary: Long-press top-row letters for digits and other keys for symbols

key.name: number-row
key.summary: Show a row of digits above the letters

key.name: swipe-typing
key.summary: Type words by sliding across the letters

key.name: key-popups
key.summary: Show the character above a key while it is pressed

key.name: space-cursor
key.summary: Slide along the space bar to move the text cursor

key.name: backspace-swipe
key.summary: Slide left from the backspace key to delete whole words

key.name: key-sound
key.summary: Play a click on each key press
key.description: Uses GNOME's sound player, so it is silent when alert sounds are off in Settings → Sound.

key.name: swipe-log
key.summary: Keep a local log of swipes and the words they were meant to be
key.description: Saved to ~/.local/share/nextkeybor/swipe-log.jsonl and never sent anywhere; used to measure and tune swipe typing. Each entry has the swipe, the word meant and the two words before it. Past 5 MB the file starts again, keeping the previous one as swipe-log.old.jsonl.

key.name: clipboard-history
key.summary: Keep the last texts you copied, in memory only, to paste from the keyboard
key.description: Nothing is written to disk; the list is gone when you log out. Copies that a password manager marks as secret (KeePassXC, KDE) are skipped, but most password managers and browsers don't mark them.

key.name: floating
key.summary: Show the keyboard as a floating panel you can drag, instead of docked at the bottom

key.name: float-width
key.summary: Floating keyboard width, in percent of the screen width

key.name: split-landscape
key.summary: In landscape, split the keys into two halves at the screen edges, for typing with both thumbs

key.name: one-handed
key.summary: One-handed mode: a narrower docked keyboard on the left or right edge

key.name: skin
key.summary: Keyboard skin
key.description: 'shell' follows the shell theme; a built-in skin (light, dark, high-contrast, nord, catppuccin-mocha); 'pywal' for pywal's colours; or 'user/FILE' for a .json or .css file in ~/.local/share/nextkeybor/skins.

key.name: float-x
key.summary: Floating keyboard left edge, as a fraction of the screen width (-1: centred)

key.name: float-y
key.summary: Floating keyboard top edge, as a fraction of the screen height (-1: near the bottom)

key.name: show-indicator
key.summary: Show a keyboard button in the top bar

key.name: height-landscape
key.summary: Keyboard height in landscape, in percent of the screen height

key.name: height-portrait
key.summary: Keyboard height in portrait, in percent of the screen height

key.name: fix-auto-capitalization
key.summary: Stop the OSK latching Shift after backspace in apps that report no surrounding text

key.name: disable-bounce-keys
key.summary: Keep GNOME's Bounce Keys off (it drops quick repeated keys, such as Backspace taps)

key.name: chromium-tap-fix
key.summary: Open the OSK when tapping text fields in Chromium, Electron and Qt apps

key.name: gif-provider
key.summary: Online GIF and sticker search provider

key.name: giphy-api-key
key.summary: GIPHY API key (free at developers.giphy.com)

key.name: klipy-api-key
key.summary: KLIPY API key (free at partner.klipy.com)

key.name: gif-content-rating
key.summary: Maximum content rating for online results

key.name: gif-cache-mb
key.summary: Size limit for the GIF thumbnail/download cache

key.name: auto-toggle-osk
key.summary: Enable the OSK only when no physical keyboard is usable

key.name: hide-osk-on-typing
key.summary: Turn the OSK off when typing on a physical keyboard

key.name: notify-keyboard-changes
key.summary: Show a notification when the OSK is switched on or off

key.name: ignored-keyboards
key.summary: Name fragments of input devices that are not real keyboards
